investigation.blocked_claim: Integration of V3-008 (PR #84) requires the operator's scope decision: row I3 (C/O stopping vs the revised ICRU 73 table) is a gating FAIL that the pre-declared scientific follow-up (amendment I3-FU-1, steps 1-3) resolved into a declared uncertainty (option (c)), not into a passing row; the orchestrator may not merge past a failed gate nor reduce the validation scope itself.
investigation.budget: Spent on the follow-up today: step 1 (one host run), step 2 (5 smokes x 4 chains, 58 evidence runs x 3 attempts + 3 repeats, ~1 s TOPAS each), 17 amendment revisions with 20+ signed Codex reviews, two STOP notes. alternatives: (A) amend the validation scope: I3 becomes a declared model limitation; merge PR #84 with the limitation declared
(B) option (b): tabulated/re-parameterised low-energy C/O stopping in a new task with licence review, circularity analysis, fresh held-out TOPAS evidence

reason_autonomous_resolution_not_possibl: Plan F.6 forbids integrating V3-008 with a gating FAIL that is neither an evidence gap nor removed by amendment; EXPERIMENT.md ("Task branches must not be merged into develop unless the relevant automated tests and validation pass"), the directive of 2026-11-01 ("Keep the existing integration gates, final requirements and stability restrictions") and the directive of 2026-10-19 ("does not authorise … merging before gates pass"; "return separately for any material scope reduction") prohibit the orchestrator from deciding this. The scientific route has been run to its end (amendment I3-FU-1 steps 1–3, 17 reviewed revisions, two STOP notes preserved in validation/plans/v3-008-acceptance.md): step 1 (committed band diagnostic, host-run RUN-20261116T164519Z-ad778a16) withdrew the recorded hypothesis on one band and showed the C/O deficit is not a single-term rescaling of the model's low-energy terms; step 2 (58 + 3 TOPAS thin-slab reference runs of a fresh seed family, evaluator sealed and signed, host-run RUN-20261116T203950Z-df7c5df4) graded INCONCLUSIVE by the pre-declared rule (the oxygen 2.4 MeV/u point failed its emulation gate twice, 0.17 % against 0.15 %) with pattern MIXED before that rule: the acceptance reference (TOPAS 4.3 / Geant4 11.4.2, opt4 EM-only) carries stopping BETWEEN ionmc and the revised ICRU 73 table and nearer to ionmc — TOPAS/ionmc − 1 = +3.5/+5.0 % (C/O) at 2–5 MeV/u, +1.4/+2.2 % at 5–10, +0.6/+1.0 % at 10–20, +0.1/+0.3 % at 20–50 MeV/u, against ICRU73_NEW/ionmc − 1 = +9.8/+13.7, +5.4/+9.4, +1.9/+4.2, +0.3/+0.8 %. Rule 2a therefore selects option (c): a tabulated low-energy source would move ionmc past the acceptance reference in every band below 20 MeV/u. Declared uncertainty (decision 0043 §1/§5, commit d66622aa): "ionmc's analytic C/O electronic stopping in water lies below the revised ICRU 73 table (libdEdx ICRU73_NEW, lineage identity with the 2009 revision OPEN) by band means of 8.6/12.2 % (C/O) at 2–5 MeV/u, 4.3/7.5 % at 5–10, 1.8/3.9 % at 10–20 and 0.3/0.8 % at 20–50 MeV/u, and by at most 0.05 % (C) / 0.1 % (O) in band mean above 50 MeV/u; the CSDA-range agreement with the table is within 0.26 % (C) / 0.39 % (O); row I3 FAILED and is not re-graded. The acceptance reference differs from ionmc by band means of +3.5/+5.0 % (C/O) at 2–5 MeV/u, +1.4/+2.2 % at 5–10, +0.6/+1.0 % at 10–20 and +0.1/+0.3 % at 20–50 MeV/u (one-step thin-slab mean energy loss; 0.2 % method systematic; the oxygen 2.4 MeV/u point invalid after its repeat), i.e. it lies between ionmc and the table and nearer to ionmc. Not a clinical claim." The affected region is the last ≈ 0.4 mm (C 290 MeV/u) / ≈ 0.3 mm (O 350 MeV/u) of range, traversed by every beam; the declared domains are unchanged. Everything else on the branch passed its gates (signed reviews, validation records, CI green at the last pushed heads); no gate was relaxed and no scientific tolerance changed.
